seo.title: Caffeine Easy — Track When Caffeine Clears
seo.description: Know exactly when caffeine leaves your system. Half-life decay visualization, quick-log presets, clear-by time, and HealthKit sync. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: CAFFEINE TRACKER
hero.title: Know when your caffeine clears.
text: Track your caffeine intake and see exactly when it leaves your system. Half-life science meets simple design.

screenshots.alt: Caffeine Easy — See the Decay Curve
screenshots.label: See the Decay Curve

items.title: Half-Life Decay Visualization
items.text: Watch your caffeine levels decay in real-time. Our beautiful chart shows exactly how much caffeine is in your system right now and when it will be gone.

items.title: Quick-Log Presets
items.text: Log your caffeine in seconds. Tap preset buttons for espresso, coffee, tea, energy drinks, and more. Custom amounts when you need them.

items.title: Clear-By Time
items.text: The "Clear By" time tells you when caffeine will drop below 20mg — effectively out of your system. Perfect for planning your last coffee before bed.

items.title: HealthKit Sync
items.text: Automatically sync your caffeine intake to Apple Health. Track alongside your sleep and other health data to see the full picture.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show current caffeine level and clear-by time at a glance. Always know where you stand.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: No servers, no cloud sync, no network requests. Your caffeine data stays on your device. Period.

sections.label: THE SCIENCE
sections.title: 5.7 hours.
text: That's the average half-life of caffeine. Every 5.7 hours, half the caffeine in your system is metabolized away. We use this to calculate exactly how much caffeine remains in your system at any moment — so you can make smarter decisions about when to drink (and when to stop).

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Caffeine Easy doesn't even make network requests. Your data lives on your device and nowhere else.

cta.title: Track your caffeine.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
